syllabusTopics: Cubical expansion, superficial expansion and their relation with linear expansion
Dulong and Petit method of determining expansivity of liquid
agentNotes: Authoring contract: frontend/AGENTS.md §9 (extra unit card). Exam bank: three-expansivity relation (2022), alpha definition (2022), 1 m rod numerical (2021).

card.title: Exam bank — every board question on thermal expansion

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Three questions: define all three expansivities plus derive 1:2:3 (2022), alpha definition with formula and unit (2022), 1 m rod 20 to 100 C numerical (2021: ~0.96 mm). Cube geometry (dV/V = 3 dL/L) derives the ratio; absolute liquid expansion adds the vessel term back.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: dL = alpha L dT (1/K) · beta = 2 alpha, gamma = 3 alpha · liquid: gamma_abs = gamma_app + gamma_vessel · rod: 1.2x10^-5 x 1 x 80 ~ 0.96 mm

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: 1:2:3 needs small rises in isotropic solids (meaning large dT or anisotropic crystals break it). Apparent expansion is instrument-relative (change vessel, change reading). Bimetallic bending needs bonded differing alpha.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Water contracts to 4 C then expands (lakes freeze top-down). Invar barely expands (survey tapes). Rail gaps and sagging lines are expansion engineering made visible.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: NEB 2021 (3): 1.2x10^-5 x 1 x 80 = 9.6x10^-4 m ~ 0.96 mm. NEB 2022 (3): three definitions, then cube dV = 3L2 dL giving gamma = 3 alpha (square face gives beta = 2 alpha). NEB 2022 (2): alpha as fractional length change per kelvin, 1/K.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Mark-losers: ratio quoted without small-strain caveat; apparent reported as absolute (vessel term dropped); alpha drifting with T ignored at large dT.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: Cube V = L3 differentiates to dV/V = 3 dL/L; square face analogously doubles. Absolute liquid: observed rise equals liquid growth minus vessel growth. Dulong-Petit U-tube isolates true liquid expansivity.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: 'Define all three + relation' means definitions then the cube in three lines. Units per kelvin. Apparent questions always add the vessel term back.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB 2022 (3): three expansivities + relation. NEB 2022 (2): alpha + formula + unit. NEB 2021 (3): 1 m rod numerical.
